blocks.text: BATAC CITY, ILOCOS NORTE, Philippines — Holding placards and raising calls for the protection of land, life, and national sovereignty, youth-led progressive groups, students, and church leaders staged protests in Northern Luzon on Monday, Nov. 16, against the Pax Silica initiative and what they described as environmental plunder.
